reviews.author: bayan abdulaziz
reviews.text:
Today I visited Hyra Salon with my mom, and it was a really pleasant experience from start to finish. The owner welcomed us warmly, and the entire team was kind, friendly, and easy to feel comfortable around. We went in to get our hair done, and honestly, we were very happy with the results. Both of our hairstyles turned out beautifully better than we expected. What stood out to me the most was how well the styling lasted throughout the day without losing its shape.
I also had my eyebrows done there, and I was really pleased with how they turned out. The team paid attention to detail and made sure everything was done properly. Overall, it was a great experience. The atmosphere was relaxed, and the staff were always smiling, which made us feel at ease. They truly deserve five stars, and I would definitely visit again.Thank you to the owner and the team for the excellent service!

reviews.author: Tasneem Naeem
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with my experience at this salon. I came in for a facial, and shortly after, my entire face broke out in severe acne. It seems like either the products used were too harsh/expired, or proper hygiene wasn't followed.

​
reviews.owner_reply:
We’re sorry to hear that you were unhappy with your experience. However, we would like to respectfully disagree with the suggestion that unhygienic practices or expired products were involved. We follow proper hygiene and sanitation procedures before, during, and after every facial, and all our products are branded and sourced responsibly.

Skin can sometimes react unexpectedly to facial treatments depending on an individual’s skin type, sensitivity, or existing skin concerns. While we cannot comment on the exact cause of the breakout, we take every client’s concerns seriously and always aim to provide a safe, clean, and professional experience.

We understand that every client’s experience is personal, but we would like to assure our customers that we take cleanliness, hygiene, and product quality very seriously. We stand by the standards we follow at our salon and remain committed to providing professional and safe services to all our clients.

reviews.author: Sonia Matadar
reviews.text:
It’s my first month in Ajman, and I really struggled to find a salon that felt right for me. I decided to try Hyra Salon, and I’m so glad I did! A huge shoutout to Nancy, who did my face wax, eyebrows, facial, and waxing—her service was absolutely incredible!

She was gentle, professional, and truly paid attention to detail. I felt so comfortable and well taken care of the entire time. It’s rare to find someone who genuinely cares about their client’s experience, but Nancy made sure everything was perfect.

I’ll definitely be coming back regularly and will specifically request Nancy every time. Highly recommend Hyra Salon—especially if you’re new to the area and still searching for “your place” like I was.
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you for your valuable feedback. Looking forward to welcoming you again😊

reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at Hyra Beauty Salon! I got my eyebrows shaped, face wax, full hands and legs waxing, and a haircut — all done by Nancy. The salon is clean, welcoming, and has a relaxing ambiance. Highly recommend Nancy for her skill and friendly attitude. I’ll definitely be visiting again!
